title: epan: Use unsigned lengths for some field types in proto API
description:
For the functions that only add a FT_{ABSOLUTE,RELATIVE}_TIME,
FT_IPXNET, FT_IPv4, FT_IPv6, FT_GUID, FT_OID, FT_REL_OID,
FT_SYSTEM_OID, and FT_ETHER, use unsigned lengths. The existing
functions already throw an exception if a negative length is used,
and no dissector in the repository uses a fixed negative length with
these.

This requires creating a static proto_tree_add_pi_unsigned function
due to the length being passed in as a pointer.

Ping #20103
